name: BYD
summary:
BYD is a diversified technology and manufacturing group with businesses in automobiles, electronics, new energy and rail transit. Established in Shenzhen in 1994, it began with rechargeable batteries and expanded into electric vehicles and related systems. Its vehicle portfolio includes BYD, Denza, Fangchengbao and Yangwang.

A defining feature of the company is vertical integration: it develops batteries, motors and electronic controls alongside key materials and complete products. This connects component development with manufacturing and after-sales services across its operations. Its principal public company materials describe this wider industrial and energy ecosystem; the group should be understood in that broader manufacturing context.
